verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party feature for tracking New Relic's own spend, attributing ingest cost to teams/services, or alerting on usage spikes before billing; docs-15 only covers monitoring customers' cloud/Kubernetes spend, not NR's own billing. Instead, multiple community reports describe unexpected ingest/cost spikes (JFR enabled automatically, log collection defaults, metric-name explosion) that went undetected until the bill arrived, with support unable to help filter usage.
